column1: # tests/ci/shards.tsv -- the DECLARED CI shard table ([CI-SHARD], lane cishard).
# `make test-shard SHARD=K/N` runs exactly the sections whose `shard` column is K
# (N = the highest shard number here, which .github/workflows/ci.yml's matrix
# must also list). tests/ci/check_shards.sh (make test-ci-shards, a TEST_SECTIONS
# member) holds this table to TEST_SECTIONS EXACTLY: every section in exactly one
# shard, no unknown names. Rows are kept in TEST_SECTIONS order; a section runs
# in the order it has here.
# weight_s is LOCAL-BOX seconds (Ryzen 7 7700X, make -j<=4), a FIRST-PASS number
# to be REPLACED by the runner's measured times: run CI, download the three
# which overwrites weight_s/weight_source for the measured sections (runner
# seconds then, not local) and re-balances. Until then the projection uses
# ci_scale (below): the ratio of the one runner datum there is (citime_report.md
# s1: the 4-vCPU run reached test-memfn-g2 at minute 76 = 4560 s) to the local
# weight sum of the sections before it (3157 s) = 1.44.
